newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BTA to resume trade at 1205 GMT.
newsitem.headline: BTA to resume trade at 1205 GMT.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Totta e Acores will resume trade on Lisbon bourse at 1205 GMT after a brief suspension, a bourse spokesman said.
The suspension was ordered earlier on Friday after a newspaper reported that government advisers had valued shares to be sold at a coming privatisation at 3,000 escudos.
The Diario Economico newspaper reported on Friday that the evaluation was made by ING Barings and Arthur Andersen.
The shares closed at 2,740 escudos on Thursday.
The Portuguese government said on Thursday that its 13.22 percent stake in Banco Totta would be sold mainly through direct sale to international and national investors.
The sale is expected to take place in November. Banco Totta forms part of the Champalimaud group.
